text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale General holds 54 vials of ibutilide fumarate 0.1 mg/mL 10 mL (11.9 days on hand at 4.5 vials per day) and Corvale Lakeside holds 12 vials (12.3 days on hand at 1 vial per day). The rule-based best option is to purchase from Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show ibutilide fumarate is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; the earlier shortage first posted on 2022-04-29 is resolved. The marketed presentation names Pharmacia & Upjohn Company LLC (FEI 1810189) as the registered plant for analysis, API manufacture, labeling, manufacture, and pack. FDA inspected that plant most recently in inspection 1208260, which ended on 2023-06-16 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2024-09-10.

Our position: Current inventory provides limited days on hand at both sites. The prior shortage is resolved per FDA records. An alternative supplier is available and not listed in shortage.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place order with Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc. — requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to confirm receipt timeline and allocate stock to both sites — requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to monitor daily usage and update days-on-hand weekly — requires Pharmacy Manager approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes; no allocation restrictions beyond current practice.
